steps.title: Start with a stripped top end
steps.instruction: Engine out on the bench, oil and coolant drained, head, cylinder and piston removed (top end guide). Cover the crankcase mouth.
verification: Top end off, engine on the bench.

steps.title: Remove the left cover and generator rotor
steps.instruction: Mark and remove the shift pedal. Remove the left crankcase cover bolts, cover, gasket and dowels. Hold the rotor, remove the nut and washer, pull the generator rotor with a rotor puller and remove the woodruff key. Remove the stator and pickup if they need renewing.

steps.title: Remove the starter motor
steps.instruction: Remove the starter motor covers and bolts and pull the starter out.

steps.title: Remove the clutch
steps.instruction: Remove the clutch cover and O-ring. Undo the six clutch spring bolts criss-cross and remove the springs, pressure plate, push rod 1 with its circlip, washer and bearing, the ball and push rod 2. Remove the plates in order. Flatten the lock washer, hold the boss with a universal clutch holder and remove the boss nut and lock washer, then the clutch boss, thrust washer, primary driven gear and push lever shaft.

steps.title: Measure the clutch
steps.instruction: Friction plates 2.92–3.08 mm, wear limit 2.82 mm (measure at four points; replace as a set). Clutch plate warpage limit 0.10 mm (replace as a set). Clutch spring free length 48.00 mm, limit 45.60 mm (replace as a set). Push rod 2 bend limit 0.10 mm. Check housing dogs and boss splines for pitting, the pressure plate for cracks and the push lever shaft for wear.

steps.title: Remove the right crankcase cover
steps.instruction: Remove the oil filter cover and element, radiator pipe 2, then the right crankcase cover bolts, cover, gasket, dowels and collar.

steps.title: Remove and check the starter clutch
steps.instruction: Remove the starter clutch holder (2 bolts), washer, damper and starter clutch. Fit the drive gear onto the starter clutch: it must turn freely counterclockwise and lock clockwise. Check gears for chips or wear.
verification: Starter clutch locks one way only.

steps.title: Remove the balancer and primary gears
steps.instruction: Flatten the lock washer tabs. Wedge an aluminium plate between the balancer drive and weight gears and loosen the balancer nut, the primary drive gear nut and the balancer weight gear nut. Remove the balancer, straight key, conical washer, primary drive gear, balancer drive gear, lock washers and balancer weight gear. Check the balancer for cracks and the gears for wear.

steps.title: Remove and check the oil pump
steps.instruction: Remove the oil pump bolts and the pump. Strip it: cover, outer rotor, dowel, inner rotor, drive shaft and housing. Measure rotor tip clearance 0.00–0.15 mm, limit 0.23 mm; outer rotor to housing 0.13–0.18 mm, limit 0.25 mm; housing-to-rotor side clearance 0.06–0.11 mm, limit 0.18 mm; out of limit means a new pump.

steps.title: Remove the shift mechanism
steps.instruction: Pull the shift shaft with its spring, collar and roller. Remove the shift guide bolts and take the shift guide and shift lever assembly off together. Turn the segment counterclockwise to its stop and remove its bolt without knocking the stopper lever; remove segment, stopper lever, collar and spring.

steps.title: Remove the timing chain
steps.instruction: Remove the exhaust chain guide, its stopper plate and the timing chain.

steps.title: Split the crankcases
steps.instruction: Lay the engine left side down. Loosen the twelve case bolts (five 45 mm, four 60 mm, three 75 mm) a quarter turn at a time criss-cross and remove them. Lever only at the splitting slots and tap the reinforced bosses with a soft hammer; lift the right case off evenly, leaving the crank and gearbox in the left case. If it sticks, find the missed fastener; never force it.

steps.title: Remove the gearbox
steps.instruction: Note where each shift fork sits and which way it faces. Remove the guide bars and springs, the shift cam and forks 3, 2 and 1, then tap the drive axle lightly and lift both axles out together. Remove the collar.

steps.title: Remove the crank and balancer shaft
steps.instruction: Lift the balancer shaft out with its flat side toward the crank. Press the crankshaft out of the left case with the crankcase separating tool.

steps.title: Measure the crankshaft
steps.instruction: Runout limit 0.030 mm (0.0012 in), turning slowly. Crank width 61.93–62.00 mm (2.438–2.441 in). Check the crank sprocket and blow out the journal oil passage. A crank out of limit is replaced; connecting rod and big-end rebuild is not covered here.

steps.title: Inspect the gearbox
steps.instruction: Main and drive axle runout limit 0.08 mm (0.0032 in). Check gears for blueing, pitting or wear and dogs for cracks or rounded edges, and that every gear slides freely. Roll the guide bars on a flat surface (bent bars replaced, never straightened). Check fork followers and pawls, fork movement on the bars, and the shift cam grooves and segment.

steps.title: Clean and inspect the cases
steps.instruction: Wash the cases, remove all old sealant, blow out the oil passages and check for cracks. Turn each case bearing by hand; a rough or loose one is pressed out by its inner race (never reused) and a new one pressed in by its outer race. Refit the bearing cover plates with threadlocker: crank bearing plate screws 22 N·m (16 lb·ft), other plate bolts 12 N·m (8.9 lb·ft). Fit a new left case oil seal 0–0.5 mm deep.
verification: Cases clean; bearings and seals checked or renewed.

steps.title: Fit the crankshaft
steps.instruction: Grease the seal lips with lithium-soap grease and coat the journals with molybdenum disulfide grease. Pull the crank into the left case bearing with the crankshaft installer pot, bolt, M12 adapter and spacer, holding the rod at TDC, until it bottoms. Fit the balancer shaft.

steps.title: Build and fit the gearbox
steps.instruction: Main axle: 5th pinion (21T), 3rd (20T), collar, 4th (22T), 2nd (15T). Drive axle: collar, 2nd wheel (23T), 4th (24T), 3rd (26T), 5th (20T), collar, 1st (27T), new O-ring; washer and new circlip with its sharp edge away from the gear and ends on a spline crest. Molybdenum disulfide oil on idler and sliding gear bores. Fit the collar with its slit facing the crankcase past the seal lip, drop both axles in together, then fork 1 (L) into 4th wheel, fork 3 (R) into 5th wheel, fork 2 (C) into 3rd pinion, the shift cam, the guide bars and springs. Oil everything and check every gear selects.

steps.title: Close the crankcases
steps.instruction: Fit the oil nozzle with threadlocker at 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft), the dowels and a greased O-ring, and apply Yamaha bond No. 1215 to the mating face. Lower the right case on with the rod at TDC, tapping gently. Tighten the twelve case bolts in two stages criss-cross to 12 N·m (8.9 lb·ft). Crank and gearbox must turn freely.
verification: Cases closed at 12 N·m; everything turns freely.

steps.title: Fit the shift mechanism
steps.instruction: Fit the stopper lever spring, collar and lever with threadlocker on its bolt at 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft). With the lever pushed down, fit the segment with its notch on the shift cam pin, oil the bolt shank and tighten to 30 N·m (22 lb·ft) without knocking the lever. Oil and assemble the pawls, pins and springs into the shift lever, fit it together with the shift guide and tighten the guide bolts to 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft) with threadlocker. Fit the oiled roller, spring, collar and shift shaft and a new shaft oil seal.
verification: Shift parts torqued; gears change by hand.

steps.title: Fit the timing chain
steps.instruction: Fit the timing chain over the crank sprocket and the exhaust chain guide with its stopper plate at 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft) with threadlocker.

steps.title: Fit the oil pump
steps.instruction: Oil the drive shaft and inner rotor, fit the dowel in the inner rotor groove, the oiled outer rotor and the cover with its screw at 2.0 N·m (1.5 lb·ft). Fit the pump with threadlocker on its bolts at 5 N·m (3.7 lb·ft). It must turn smoothly.

steps.title: Fit the balancer and primary gears
steps.instruction: Fit the balancer weight gear with its lower spline on the balancer shaft lower spline. Fit the balancer drive gear with its punch mark on the weight gear punch mark and its lower spline on the crank lower spline. Fit a new lock washer and the weight gear nut at 50 N·m (37 lb·ft). Fit the primary drive gear, a new conical washer (convex side out) and the oiled primary drive gear nut at 80 N·m (59 lb·ft), with an aluminium plate wedging the gears. Fit the straight key, the balancer, a new lock washer and the balancer nut at 45 N·m (33 lb·ft). Bend the lock washer tabs.
verification: Balancer marks aligned; 50, 80 and 45 N·m done; tabs bent.

steps.title: Refit the starter clutch
steps.instruction: Fit the starter clutch, damper, washer and holder; holder bolts with threadlocker at 12 N·m (8.9 lb·ft).

steps.title: Fit the right cover
steps.instruction: Fit a new cover oil seal (marks inward, greased lip), the washer and a new circlip. Fit the dowels, greased new O-rings, the collar and a new gasket. Oil the impeller shaft end and fit the cover so the impeller shaft end engages the slot in the balancer end; bolts in stages criss-cross to 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft). Refit radiator pipe 2 (joint bolt 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft)), a new oil filter element and the filter cover at 10 N·m.
verification: Right cover 10 N·m; impeller engaged; new filter.

steps.title: Rebuild the clutch
steps.instruction: Fit the push lever shaft (greased seal lip, oiled sliding surface). Fit the oiled primary driven gear, thrust washer and clutch boss. Fit a new lock washer with its notch on the rib of the boss and the oiled boss nut; hold the boss with the universal clutch holder, tighten to 75 N·m (55 lb·ft) and bend the lock washer tab. Fit the oiled plates starting and ending with a friction plate, from the boss side: three friction plates 1, three purple-marked friction plates 2, then two friction plates 1, with a clutch plate between each. Fit the bearing, washer and a new circlip on push rod 1, then oiled push rod 2, the ball and push rod 1. Fit the pressure plate, springs and spring bolts in stages criss-cross to 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft). Fit a greased new cover O-ring and the clutch cover at 10 N·m.
verification: Plate order correct; spring bolts and cover 10 N·m.

steps.title: Fit the stator and generator rotor
steps.instruction: Fit the stator with threadlocker on its screws at 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft) (T25 bit), the crank position sensor bolts at 10 N·m with threadlocker and the lead holder bolt at 8 N·m (5.9 lb·ft) with threadlocker; seal the lead grommet with Yamaha bond No. 1215. Clean the tapers, fit the woodruff key flat side parallel to the crank, the rotor, washer and nut at 65 N·m (48 lb·ft). Fit dowels, a new gasket, the cover and lead holder with the bolts criss-cross at 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft).

steps.title: Refit the starter motor
steps.instruction: Grease the starter O-ring, refit the starter and covers: starter bolts 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft), cover bolt 10 N·m.

steps.title: Final hand check
steps.instruction: Turn the crank by hand through several turns in neutral and in each gear: smooth, no tight spots.
verification: Engine turns freely; all gears select.

steps.title: Continue with the top end
steps.instruction: Build the top end with the top end guide, refit the engine, fill with 0.90 L (0.95 US qt) of oil and follow the first start and break-in guide. A new crankshaft or gears means the full break-in.

verification: Push rod 2, chain guide and timing chain out.

steps.title: Split the crankcases
steps.instruction: Lay the engine left side down. Loosen the nine case bolts a quarter turn at a time in a criss-cross pattern, then remove them, noting their lengths (45, 60 and 75 mm). Lever only at the splitting slots and tap the reinforced bosses with a soft hammer; lift the right case off evenly, leaving the crank and gearbox in the left case. If it sticks, look for a bolt you missed; do not force it.
verification: Cases apart without prying on the sealing faces.

steps.title: Remove the gearbox
steps.instruction: Note the position and direction of each shift fork. Remove the long and short fork guide bars with their springs, the shift drum and forks 3, 2 and 1. Tap the drive axle lightly with a soft hammer and lift both axles out together. Remove the collar.

steps.title: Remove the crank and balancer
steps.instruction: Lift out the balancer shaft with its flat side toward the crank. Press the crankshaft out of the left case with the crankcase separating tool.

steps.title: Measure the crankshaft
steps.instruction: Runout limit 0.030 mm (0.0012 in), turning slowly in V-blocks. Crank width 61.93–62.00 mm (2.438–2.441 in). Check the crank sprocket and blow out the journal oil passage. A crank out of limit is replaced as an assembly; connecting rod and big-end service is not covered here.

steps.title: Inspect the gearbox
steps.instruction: Main and drive axle runout limit 0.08 mm (0.0032 in). Check gears for blueing, pitting or wear and dogs for cracks or rounded edges, and that each gear slides freely. Roll the guide bars on a flat surface (bent bars are replaced, never straightened). Check fork followers and pawls, fork movement on the bars, and drum grooves and segment.
verification: Gearbox and selectors checked; measurements recorded.

steps.title: Clean and inspect the cases
steps.instruction: Wash the cases, remove all old sealant, blow out the oil passages and check for cracks. Clean the oil strainer. Turn each case bearing by hand; a rough or loose bearing is pressed out by its inner race (never reused) and a new one pressed in by its outer race, flush (0 mm). Refit the bearing cover plates with threadlocker: crank bearing plate screws 30 N·m (22 lb·ft), other plate bolts 12 N·m (8.9 lb·ft). Fit a new left case oil seal 0–0.5 mm deep.
verification: Cases clean; bearings and seals checked or renewed.

steps.title: Fit the crankshaft
steps.instruction: Grease the seal lips with lithium-soap grease and coat the journals with molybdenum disulfide oil. Pull the crank into the left case bearing with the crankshaft installer pot, bolt, M12 adapter and spacer, holding the rod at TDC, until it bottoms. Fit the balancer shaft.

steps.title: Build and fit the gearbox
steps.instruction: Main axle: 4th (22T), 3rd (20T), collar, 5th (21T), 2nd (16T). Drive axle: collar, 2nd (26T), 5th (21T), 3rd (27T), 4th (25T), collar, 1st (28T), new O-ring; washer and new circlip with its sharp edge away from the gear and ends on a spline crest. Molybdenum disulfide oil on idler and sliding gear bores. Fit the collar past the seal lip, drop both axles in together, then fork 1 (L) into 5th wheel, fork 2 (C) into 3rd pinion, fork 3 (R) into 4th wheel, the drum, the guide bars and springs. Oil everything and check every gear selects.
verification: Gearbox in; all gears select by turning the drum.

steps.title: Close the crankcases
steps.instruction: Fit oil nozzle 1 to the right case (bolt 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft) with threadlocker) and oil nozzle 2 to the left case at 0.5 N·m (0.37 lb·ft). Fit the strainer, dowels and gasket and apply Yamaha bond No. 1215 to the mating face. Lower the right case on with the rod at TDC, tapping gently. Tighten the case bolts in two stages in a criss-cross pattern to 12 N·m (8.9 lb·ft). The crank and gearbox must turn freely.
verification: Cases closed, bolts 12 N·m; crank and gearbox turn freely.

steps.title: Fit the shift mechanism
steps.instruction: Fit the stopper lever spring, collar and lever with threadlocker on its bolt at 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft). Push the stopper lever down and fit the segment with its projections in the drum slits; segment bolt 30 N·m (22 lb·ft) without knocking the lever. Oil and assemble the pawls, pins and springs into the shift lever, fit the lever with the shift guide and tighten the guide bolts to 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft) with threadlocker. Fit the dowel, roller, spring, collar and oiled shift shaft, and a new shift shaft oil seal.
verification: Shift parts torqued; gears change by hand.

steps.title: Fit timing chain and push rod 2
steps.instruction: Fit the timing chain over the crank sprocket, the exhaust chain guide and its stopper plate with threadlocker at 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft). Fit push rod 2 with a new oil seal 0–0.5 mm deep in the left side.
verification: Chain, guide and push rod in.

steps.title: Fit the oil pump
steps.instruction: Oil and assemble the pump: drive shaft, dowel in the slot of inner rotor 2, outer rotor 2, cover with threadlocker on its bolt at 6 N·m (4.4 lb·ft), dowel in the groove of inner rotor 1, rotor 1 set and circlip. Fit the pump with threadlocker on its bolts at 5 N·m (3.7 lb·ft). It must turn smoothly.

steps.title: Fit balancer and primary gears
steps.instruction: Fit the oil pump drive gear and the balancer driven gear with the lower splines of gear and shaft lined up. Fit the balancer drive gear with its punch mark on the driven gear punch mark and its lower spline on the crank lower spline. Degrease the crank thread, washer and nut, then grease them with molybdenum disulfide grease. Fit a new lock washer and the balancer driven gear nut at 50 N·m (37 lb·ft). Fit the starter clutch (maker mark out, at least 0.7 mm clear of the drive gear), circlip, oiled reduction gear, collar, primary drive gear, washer and a new primary drive gear nut at 170 N·m (125 lb·ft) with an aluminium plate wedging the gears. Bend the lock washer tab.
verification: Balancer marks aligned; 50 N·m and 170 N·m done; tab bent.

steps.title: Fit the right cover
steps.instruction: Fit a new oil seal (0 mm, marks inward, greased lip), new circlip and the check ball seat in the cover. Fit the dowels and a new gasket, then the cover with its bolts in stages criss-cross to 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft). Fit a new oil filter element and the cover at 10 N·m.
verification: Right cover 10 N·m; new filter fitted.

steps.title: Rebuild the clutch
steps.instruction: Oil the main axle, washer, idle gear collar, primary driven gear and washer, then fit washer, idle gear, collar, driven gear, washer, clutch boss, absorbers, sleeve, washer and spacer (washer not caught on the spacer step). Oil a new clutch boss nut, hold the sleeve and tighten it to 75 N·m (55 lb·ft); the washer must still turn; stake the nut into the axle cutouts without marking the threads. Fit the oiled collars, then the oiled plates from the boss side out: 1.0 mm clutch plate, blue-marked friction plate 2, 1.4 mm clutch plate, friction plate 2, then 1.4 mm clutch plates alternating with the four unpainted friction plates 1, then friction plate 2, 1.4 mm clutch plate, friction plate 2 and the second 1.0 mm clutch plate last (9 clutch plates, 8 friction plates). Fit the push rod 1 bearing with a new circlip, the greased ball and push rod 1, pressure plate 2, the retainer, spring and pressure plate 1; run the oiled bolts to 4.0 N·m (3.0 lb·ft) then 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft) criss-cross. Clutch cover with a new gasket at 10 N·m.
verification: Boss nut 75 N·m and staked; plate order correct; pressure plate bolts 10 N·m.

steps.title: Fit the generator
steps.instruction: Fit the stator with threadlocker on its screws at 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft) (T25 bit) and the crank position sensor bolts at 10 N·m with threadlocker; seal the lead grommet with Yamaha bond No. 1215. Clean the taper on crank and rotor, fit the woodruff key flat side parallel to the crank, the rotor, washer and nut at 65 N·m (48 lb·ft). Fit dowels, a new gasket, the cover and holders with the bolts criss-cross at 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft).

steps.title: Refit the starter motor
steps.instruction: Grease the starter O-ring and refit the starter with its bolt at 10 N·m (7.4 lb·ft).

steps.title: Final hand check
steps.instruction: Turn the crank by hand through several turns with the gearbox in neutral and then in each gear: it must turn smoothly with no tight spots.
verification: Engine turns freely; all gears select.

steps.title: Continue with the top end
steps.instruction: Build the top end with the top end guide, refit the engine, fill with 1.20 L (1.27 US qt) of oil and follow the first start and break-in guide. A new crankshaft or gears means the full break-in.
